description: Defines the WebSocketDeflateParameters class for handling permessage-deflate extension parameters in WebSocket communication, including validation, configuration, and compatibility checks.

classes.name: WebSocketDeflateParameters
classes.description: Represents permessage-deflate extension parameters for WebSocket, providing methods for validation, configuration, and compatibility.

methods.name: AsExtension
methods.description: Returns a WebSocketExtension object containing the parameters.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the parameters from a WebSocketExtension input, returning success status and failure message.

methods.name: IsCompatibleWith
methods.description: Checks if this set of parameters is compatible with another.

methods.name: IsValidAsRequest
methods.description: Validates the parameters as a request.

methods.name: IsValidAsResponse
methods.description: Validates the parameters as a response.

methods.name: server_context_take_over_mode
methods.description: Returns the server's context take over mode.

methods.name: client_context_take_over_mode
methods.description: Returns the client's context take over mode.

methods.name: is_server_max_window_bits_specified
methods.description: Checks if server max window bits are specified.

methods.name: server_max_window_bits
methods.description: Returns the server's max window bits value.

methods.name: is_client_max_window_bits_specified
methods.description: Checks if client max window bits are specified.

methods.name: has_client_max_window_bits_value
methods.description: Checks if the client max window bits has a value.

methods.name: client_max_window_bits
methods.description: Returns the client's max window bits value.

methods.name: SetServerNoContextTakeOver
methods.description: Sets server to no context takeover mode.

methods.name: SetClientNoContextTakeOver
methods.description: Sets client to no context takeover mode.

methods.name: SetServerMaxWindowBits
methods.description: Sets the server's max window bits.

methods.name: SetClientMaxWindowBits
methods.description: Sets the client's max window bits.

methods.name: PermissiveServerMaxWindowBits
methods.description: Returns permissive server max window bits.

methods.name: PermissiveClientMaxWindowBits
methods.description: Returns permissive client max window bits.

methods.name: IsValidWindowBits
methods.description: Checks if a value is valid for window bits.
